nobox.final_span:
Valley and Roaring Fork schools aim to rebalance the mental health marijuana tax funds.
Interestingly, children this fall will have more choices for getting aid.
In addition to what Martin described as a “leveled up mental health system” run by Eagle County’s Total Health Alliance, Colorado Crisis Service has announced a brand-new Trevor Project Crisis Line for teens. And, Martin added, the regional psychiatric clinic for children—Child and Family services—has obtained its state license and is now operational.
Steps Forward in Mental Health: Supports, Case Management, Community Services, Treatment.
In the autumn of 2017 at the Eagle County Peak Parenting class, Kate Eastwood, executive director of the Vail Health Mental Health Institute, discussed what constitutes a healthy community and the broad reach of the Mental Health Alliance.
